## Hypothesis

Validate the reported OOS performance of the V14E_PARAM_SWEEP_26K candidate using cached real OPRA fills for 2025-01-02..2026-06-18. Confirm whether the edge_capture of $499 and OOS Sharpe of 9.34 hold under realistic fill simulation, or if slippage and bid-ask effects degrade the edge.

## Mechanism

The candidate modifies the v14e exit structure: tp1=0.30 (exit 1/3 of position at +30% premium), runner=2.5 (trail runner at 2.5× initial risk), profit_lock=0.05/0.10 (arm profit lock at +5%, trail to +10%). Entry logic remains the original v14e bearish setup trigger. Exit uses chart-stop as primary invalidation, with the above profit-lock and runner rules applied after TP1 fills.
